question: For how many days is the Hornbill festival held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Hornbill Festival:

__
 
• The Hornbill Festival is a celebration held every year from 1 to 10 December, in Nagaland.
 
• It is also called the 'Festival of Festivals'.
 
• It showcases the rich and diverse Naga ethnicity through folk dances, traditional music, local cuisine, handicraft, art workshops, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nagaland is a mountainous state in northeast India, bordering Myanmar.
 
• It's home to diverse indigenous tribes, with festivals and markets celebrating the different tribes' cultures.
 
• It is also popularly known as the 'land of festivals and every tribal festival is celebrated with pomp and gaiety, adorned with rich and colourful traditional attires.
